notes.title: MILFs of Sunville: Season 2v7 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a major bug that was breaking the game.
[/list]
A bug was discovered during the initialization of a new quest with Clark.

This error could lead to corruption of random game data in the current save. Although 80% of players have not encountered any issues, we recommend loading a save from before the update after installing the new patch.

Thank you to the players for helping identify the problem.

[b]Enjoy the Game![/b]

notes.title: MILFs of Sunville: Season 2 patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented quests from the new update from starting when using auto-saves made while viewing the game's gallery.
[/list]

Thank you to the players who provided their game saves to help us identify this bug.

Please make sure you have updated the game.
